I am old now, 76 years, and my eyes have seen many seasons on this small plot. This piece of land with my fruit trees and enset is something my family has tended for long years — the trees give us food without needing much from outside. I cannot afford the chemical fertilizer for the perennials, and truly the trees do not need it like teff or maize does; I put the cattle manure and household ash around the base of the enset and the trees, that is what my fathers did. For the work, my sons and grandchildren help me with the weeding and harvesting, so I do not need to hire anyone.
